verdict.rationale: A community-posted log excerpt shows Ollama's own server output naming the reason for GPU fallback (an AMD GPU was detected but no compatible ROCm library was found, so it falls back to CPU). That is direct, product-emitted diagnostic text for this story, but it rests on a single hands-on mention covering one vendor path. missing for 10: first-party documentation of GPU-detection and fallback diagnostics, evidence that the output is surfaced prominently rather than buried in server logs, coverage of NVIDIA/CUDA and Apple Metal failure reasons, and independent corroboration beyond one user report.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know why GPU acceleration failed and silently fell back to CPU through clear diagnostic output

citations.quote: amdgpu detected, but no compatible rocm library found... unable to verify rocm library, will use cpu: no suitable rocm found, falling back to CPU.
